basic_profile.bio: CyberGlider_42 is a tech enthusiast and avid gamer based in Berlin, Germany. With a background in computer science, they work as a freelance ethical hacker, often traveling for assignments. They have a keen interest in Linux-based systems and enjoy tinkering with open-source software. Outside of their tech pursuits, they have a fascination with exotic pets, particularly sugar gliders, and they are a dedicated night owl, typically online late into the night. Single and exploring the world, they combine their love for technology with a passion for travel.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: CyberGlider_42 has a strong foundation in computer science, having graduated with a degree in the field from a reputable university. They have honed their skills in ethical hacking through a combination of formal education and self-teaching, often participating in online courses and forums. Their knowledge extends to the intricacies of Linux systems, acquired through years of personal projects and professional work.
